text:
ops-bot: @here New preview: Ampere A30X (a30x) Dedicated pools in europe-dub (Dublin) and me-east-tlv (Tel Aviv). Initial capacity: Dublin: 10 GPUs (2 nodes), Tel Aviv: 6 GPUs (1 node). This is a controlled preview for partner validation.
maya_pm: Quick note: preview only  no SLA, limited quotas, and not yet billable as reserved capacity. Sign-up form: https://redwood.example.com/a30x-preview. Include model families, expected throughput, and whether you need long-context support.
igor_infra: Pool names: a30x-dub-preview and a30x-tlv-preview. Both pools are non-preemptible and have default session cap 8h. Dublin HSM enabled; Tel Aviv HSM pending (ETA 48h). We disabled burst for the preview and capped per-tenant GPUs at 4. CLI example for a smoke reserve:
```
redwood reserve --pool a30x-dub-preview --count 1 --duration 4h --team=search --note "a30x smoke"
```
sophie_prod: Perf quick take (internal): 4k context p50/p95: DUB 95ms/240ms, TLV 110ms/270ms. A30X shows good single-token latency on int8 quantized models; longer contexts need KV tuning. We saw ~2% noisy first-token spikes due to cold cache on a subset of runs.
rahul_sre: Incidents: one Dublin node reported a transient power-cycle under stress tests; vendor replacement swapped the PSU and node is stable. Added an early alert for PSU faults and PCIe errors. Pager thresholds for preview: temp>=81C, mem errs>3/min.
talia_sales: GTM: partners allowed in preview: NovaSearch and ProbeAI. Do not promise GA or capacity. If a customer asks for early access, send them the sign-up link and cc me. Pricing: partner pricing for preview; retail priced at GA.
owen_security: Security: Dublin preview has HSM and audit logs; Tel Aviv is not compliant until HSM is on. Do NOT put PII or sensitive datasets on TLV preview. We'll publish a compliance checklist before GA.
maya_pm: Timeline: sign-ups open today. Infra will roll additional nodes if smoke tests remain stable. Expect a week of preview validation; we'll reassess for a broader internal rollout after that. If we hit >3 ECC/thermal incidents, we'll pause expansion.
igor_infra: Action items: enable TLV HSM (ETA 48h), add per-node PSU metric to dashboard, and publish infra-admin override docs for session caps (ETA 72h).
sophie_prod: Action: post perf spreadsheet and CI job links to #eng-runtime by EOD tomorrow. Include tuning tips for KV cache and warmup sequences.
rahul_sre: Action: add PSU replacement playbook to runbook and tune pager thresholds for a30x (ETA 48h).
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Epic created: a30x-preview-rollout. Tag any bugs with [a30x-preview] and ping owners. Thanks team!
